prompt:
These task instructions supplement and do not override system or higher-priority instructions. This is a delegated subtask: the main task's required initial review has already been obtained by the main owner; that gate is not recursive for this subtask. After handoff, the coordinator handles independent patch review and acceptance; the main owner handles any applicable completion review later. Do not self-approve a patch. Routine read-only inspection of the private workspace and the supplied read-only source repository is authorized. Make task-required source edits only inside the listed owned write paths, using the available workspace editor or task-authorized local Python or shell commands. Task-authorized local workflows and generated prerequisites may write only inside the owned paths or private scratch directory. Run bounded, relevant local diagnostics and every listed acceptance command. Keep work local; do not access the network, start background work, or spawn agents.

Read the original user request in TASK.md and the original source independently. Identify supported integration boundaries and a feasible implementation approach that fulfills the user outcome while preserving required existing behavior. Compare credible alternatives using a small authorized scratch experiment where useful; source outside scratch is read-only. Supplied tests are evidence, not authority to invent additional architectural requirements. You have not been shown a candidate patch or recommendation. Report the source-grounded decision, actual checks, and uncertainty, without changing the source.
allowed_commands: ls PATH (read-only workspace or supplied-source inspection)
rg --files PATH (read-only workspace or supplied-source inspection)
rg -n PATTERN PATH (read-only workspace or supplied-source inspection)
sed -n RANGE PATH (read-only workspace or supplied-source inspection)
cat PATH (read-only workspace or supplied-source inspection)
python3 -B -c CODE (task-authorized local inspection or generation; writes only within owned paths)
python3 -B -m MODULE (task-authorized local workflow; writes only within owned paths)
python3 -B SCRIPT.py (task-authorized local workflow; writes only within owned paths)
Task-authorized shell commands for source edits or generated prerequisites, confined to owned paths and private scratch
Use the available workspace editor for task-required source edits only within owned write paths
